logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Verification memo illustration for WO-05: an independently recomputed energy-ladder bar chart supporting the B verifier's cross-check of A's report. Four bars ordered ascending on the shared kWh acceptance basis: P2 15 (green baseline), P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 (amber, zero defect headroom). Red dashed double-arrow callouts mark consecutive gaps +9, +20 and +20 kWh; white ratio labels inside taller bars read 1.60x, 2.93x and 4.27x vs P2. Below the axis, each bar carries ID, quality, raw defects and headroom chips (4/2/2/0), with P4 explicitly at the 5/5 ceiling. Check marks signal values recomputed from the trusted table; a footnote states all figures match A's report exactly.
